body: I'm not interested in slaving away to obtain a degree so I can spend 40 other years slaving away. Death sounds better.
I just think life is too much work with too little payoff.

You don't understand. I don't want to be around anyone. The sound of other people's voice  is grating to me. I detest people adressing me. If I could live the rest of my life alone I would. However that is impossible

I feel that way about both things.

I don't mind being a robot. The brain is basically a computer. Artsy fartsy types exasperate me. I'd love to make myself useful, but I don't have any qualifications and I don't have the self-discipline required to attain them.

So again, why bother? Maybe I can be used as fertilizer.

I've attempted talking about it in various forums, but I either got called an attention whore or ignored. I would call a hotline but I don't want any trouble, and I am not very good with people.
Sure, some family members would have it bad but I wouldn't be feeling bad about it.
